mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_status AS "achievementStatus", a.achievement_detail AS "achievementDetail", a.achievement_detail::jsonb ->> 'achievementName' AS "achievementName", a.attachment_ref AS "attachmentRef", a.created_at AS "createdAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM education_achievements a WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= m.effective_end_date)

SELECT DISTINCT p.evaluation_year FROM input_period_settings p WHERE p.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND p.active_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN p.start_at AND p.end_at AND (p.organization_code IS NULL OR p.organization_code = #{organization})

SELECT m.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", m.management_item_name AS "managementItemName", m.required_yn AS "requiredYn", m.data_type AS "dataType", m.teacher_editable_yn AS "teacherEditableYn" FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.management_item_code, m.management_item_id
SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.system_use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{row.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{row.achievementDate}, achievement_detail = #{row.achievementDetail}, attachment_ref = #{row.attachmentRef}, updated_by = #{row.actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{row.achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT j.batch_job_id::text AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.organization_code AS "organizationCode", j.created_by AS "createdBy", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.job_status AS "jobStatus", j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.processed_count AS "processedCount", j.unprocessed_count AS "unprocessedCount", j.request_id AS "requestId" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{id}

SELECT i.batch_job_item_id AS "itemId", i.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", i.processed_yn AS "processedYn", i.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items i WHERE i.batch_job_id = #{id} ORDER BY i.batch_job_item_id

SELECT f.uploader_user_id AS "ownerId" FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.file_token = #{token} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT j.requester_user_id AS "ownerId" FROM excel_download_jobs j WHERE j.file_token = #{token} AND j.status = 'GENERATED'

SELECT t.template_id FROM excel_upload_templates t WHERE t.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND t.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.effective_date DESC, t.template_version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.required_column FROM excel_upload_template_rules r WHERE r.template_id = ( SELECT t.template_id FROM excel_upload_templates t WHERE t.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND t.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.effective_date DESC, t.template_version DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY r.column_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_errors ( error_id, upload_id, row_number, column_name, error_code, error_reason, correction_guide ) VALUES ( #{entry.id}, #{entry.uploadId}, #{entry.rowNumber}, #{entry.field}, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', #{entry.message}, '행 입력값과 담당 범위를 확인하세요.' )

INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories ( upload_id, total_count, success_count, error_count, saved_count, processor_user_id ) VALUES ( #{entry.uploadId}, #{entry.total}, #{entry.success}, #{entry.errors}, #{entry.saved}, #{entry.actorId} ) ON CONFLICT (upload_id) DO UPDATE SET success_count = EXCLUDED.success_count, error_count = EXCLUDED.error_count, saved_count = EXCLUDED.saved_count, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO excel_download_jobs ( download_id, requester_user_id, output_type, query_condition, file_token, original_file_name, generated_at ) VALUES ( #{entry.downloadId}, #{entry.actorId}, 'ERROR', CAST(#{entry.condition} AS jsonb), #{entry.errorToken}, '취업률_오류.xlsx', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
